description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart that summarizes the distribution of two ambiguity-related measures, with the outer ring representing “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and the inner ring representing “Max Ambiguity (Inner).” The outer ring contains four slices in progressively lighter blue shades, labeled approximately 49.0% (dark teal, “Std: 0.0”), 39.0% (medium blue, “Std: 0.47”), 5.0% (brighter blue, “Std: 0.82”), and 7.0% (light blue; the corresponding legend text appears obscured/blurred). The inner ring contains three slices in light blue shades labeled 47.7% (“Max: 1”), 38.0% (“Max: 2”), and 14.2% (“Max: 3”). Percentage labels are printed directly on the slices, and two separate legends appear on the right—one for the outer ring categories and one for the inner ring categories; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering rule.
